title: Linearity of a profile correction gate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $a:\mathbb{N}\to\{−1,1\}$ be a sign sequence, and choose a coordinate index $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The gate that is constantly $-1$ when $a(i+1)=a(i)$ and otherwise constantly $a(i+1)$ is a linear threshold function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is an index in the $n$-dimensional coordinate set
